an8.9:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] kulaputto’ ti bhikkhave, nandaṃ sammāvadamāno vadeyya;
an8.9:1.2: balavāti bhikkhave, nandaṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya;
an8.9:1.3: pāsādikoti bhikkhave, nandaṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya;
an8.9:1.5: kimaññatra bhikkhave, nando indriyesu guttadvāro bhojanesu mattaññū jāgariyaṃ anuyutto satisampajaññena samannāgato. yehi nando sakkoti paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ:
an8.9:1.6: tatrīdaṃ bhikkhave, nandassa indriyesu guttadvāratāya hoti:
an8.9:1.7: sace bhikkhave, nandassa puratthimā disā āloketabbā hoti, sabbaṃ cetasā samannāharitvā nando puratthimaṃ disaṃ āloketi,
an8.9:1.8: ‘evaṃ me puratthimaṃ disaṃ ālokayato na abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssavissantī’ti,
an8.9:2.1: sace bhikkhave, nandassa pacchimā disā āloketabbā hoti …pe…
an8.9:2.6: anudisā anuviloketabbā hoti, sabbaṃ cetasā samannāharitvā nando anudisaṃ anuviloketi.
an8.9:2.7: ‘evamme anudisaṃ anuvilokayato nābhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssavissantīti.
an8.9:2.9: idaṃ kho bhikkhave, nandassa indriyesu guttadvāratāya hoti.
an8.9:3.1: tatridaṃ bhikkhave, nandassa bhojane mattaññutāya hoti:
an8.9:3.2: idha bhikkhave nando paṭisaṅkhāyoniso āhāraṃ āhāreti:
an8.9:3.3: neva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya, yāvadeva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsūparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya, iti purāṇañca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi, navañca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi, yātrā ca me bhavissati, anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cāti.
an8.9:3.4: idaṃ kho bhikkhave, nandassa bhojane mattaññutāya hoti.
an8.9:4.2: idha bhikkhave, nando divasaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti.
an8.9:4.3: rattiyā paṭhamaṃ yāmaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti.
an8.9:4.4: rattiyā majjhimaṃ yāmaṃ dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappeti. pāde pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasikaritvā.
an8.9:4.5: rattiyā pacchimaṃ yāmaṃ paccuṭṭhāya caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti.
an8.9:4.6: idaṃ kho bhikkhave, nandassa jāgariyānuyogasmiṃ hoti.
an8.9:5.2: idha bhikkhave, nandassa viditā vedanā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti,
an8.9:5.4: viditā vitakkā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhāhanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti.
an8.9:5.5: idaṃ kho bhikkhave, nandassa satisampajaññasmiṃ hoti.
an8.9:6.1: kimaññatra bhikkhave, nando indriyesu guttadvāro bhojane mattaññū jāgariyaṃ anuyutto satisampajaññena samannāgato yehi nando sakkoti paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ caritunti.
